questions.question: What do wizards call Harry because he survived the Killing Curse as a baby?
questions.note: Voldemort's curse rebounds when Harry is a year old. The name sticks.

questions.question: What is the Dursleys' address?
questions.note: Little Whinging. Harry's Hogwarts letters are addressed to the cupboard at this house.

questions.question: Where do the Dursleys make Harry sleep before the letters start coming?
questions.note: He gets Dudley's second bedroom only after the letters will not stop.

questions.question: What is the name of Harry's cousin?
questions.note: Dudley Dursley, spoiled son of Vernon and Petunia.

questions.question: Aunt Petunia is the sister of which of Harry's parents?
questions.note: Petunia is a Muggle. Lily Evans was the witch.

questions.question: What shape is the scar on Harry's forehead?
questions.note: It is the mark left when Voldemort's curse failed.

questions.question: What does Hagrid say when he tells Harry he is a wizard?
choices: You're a liar and a thief.
questions.note: He says it in the hut on the rock, after the Dursleys flee the letters.

questions.question: From which platform does the Hogwarts Express leave?
questions.note: King's Cross. Students walk through the barrier between platforms 9 and 10.

questions.question: What wizarding shopping street does Hagrid take Harry to?
questions.note: They reach it through the backyard of the Leaky Cauldron, by tapping the right brick.

questions.question: According to Ollivander, what chooses the wizard?
questions.note: Harry's wand is holly with a phoenix feather. That same phoenix gave the feather in Voldemort's wand.
